name: BrowserPair
description: BrowserPair connects AI agents to a user's existing Chrome profile for browser tasks with scoped permissions, approvals, and durable task state.

mcp.authentication: OAuth for connected AI apps; agent keys for direct integrations

execution: Paired Chrome extension in the user's connected profile; paired browser must be online.
planning: External AI app or a user-configured Brain model for managed tasks.
dataFlow: Website sessions remain in the connected profile. Browser observations and task results can flow through BrowserPair to the connected AI app; this is not a local-only processing claim.
sourceCode: The main application source is private. The public organization contains documentation, examples, workflow guides, and community resources.
